quests.title: Read one frontier AI paper or essay
quests.description: Skim a recent post from Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, or a notable blog. Write a 3-line summary in your evidence log.

quests.title: Ship a small AI tool or improvement
quests.description: Build or improve one thing this week. CLI, script, agent — doesn't matter. It must run.

quests.title: Teach one person something AI-related
quests.description: Pair-prompt, demo a workflow, send a useful link with context. Move someone forward.

quests.title: Evaluate something objectively
quests.description: Pick an AI output you depended on this week and grade it honestly. Was it actually right? Log the finding.

quests.title: Talk to one AI practitioner outside your bubble
quests.description: DM, coffee, conference. One real conversation. Capture one insight that surprised you.

quests.title: Publish or share one piece of thinking
quests.description: Internal Slack post, blog draft, LinkedIn comment with substance. Put a stake in the ground.

quests.title: Kill a stale in-progress skill
quests.description: Look at anything you've had 'in progress' for 30+ days. Either ship it this week or honestly mark it back to unlocked.

quests.title: Surface one AI opportunity at work
quests.description: Find one place AI could save real time/money. Pitch it informally to one stakeholder this week.

quests.title: Add 5 prompts to your eval set
quests.description: Pick a workflow you use AI for. Add 5 test cases you can re-run after any prompt change.

quests.title: Read one piece of AI policy or governance
quests.description: EU AI Act summary, an internal policy at a peer company, NIST AI RMF. Note the one thing that surprised you.
